description: Look up format-pane settings of one SmartVisuals visual by a few words (e.g. 'sort', 'label size', 'reference line'). Returns each match's card, setting, the exact path as the pane shows it, its type or options and a description, read from the released package. Use it to tell a report author where a setting is.

query.description: One to four words describing the setting

name: find_setting
title: Find Setting
